commands:
set -eu
k3s kubectl get pods -A -o wide
echo SERVICES_AND_ENDPOINTS
k3s kubectl get svc,endpoints -A
 echo BACKING_SERVICES
k3s kubectl exec -n phantom deployment/phantom-postgres -- pg_isready -U phantom -d phantom
k3s kubectl exec -n phantom deployment/phantom-redis -- redis-cli ping
echo HTTP_HEALTH
k3s kubectl exec -n phantom deployment/phantom-api-gateway -- python3 -c "import urllib.request,sys; urls=['http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz','http://127.0.0.1:8080/readyz','http://phantom-causal-engine:8080/healthz','http://phantom-causal-engine:8080/readyz','http://phantom-sbom-service:8080/healthz','http://phantom-sbom-service:8080/readyz','http://phantom-sink.phantom-eval:9191/healthz','http://phantom-sink.phantom-eval:9191/readyz']; failed=[];
for u in urls:
 try:
  r=urllib.request.urlopen(u,timeout=5); body=r.read(200).decode(); print(str(r.status)+' '+u+' '+body); failed += [u] if r.status>=400 else []
 except Exception as e: print('ERROR '+u+' '+type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)); failed.append(u)
sys.exit(bool(failed))"
echo PROMETHEUS_TARGETS
k3s kubectl exec -n phantom deployment/phantom-api-gateway -- python3 -c "import json,urllib.request; d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('http://prometheus.monitoring.svc.cluster.local:9090/api/v1/targets',timeout=5)); [print(t.get('labels',{}).get('job'),t.get('health'),t.get('lastError','')) for t in d['data']['activeTargets']]"
